note: Champions live in Wild Rift but not yet present in our ranked-player dataset.

abilities.name: Carnivore
abilities.text: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers 40 - 82 (based on level) Health.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.text: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.

abilities.name: Feral Scream
abilities.text: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Vorpal Spikes
abilities.text: Cho'gath's attacks passively release deadly spines, dealing damage to all enemy units in front of him.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.text: Devours an enemy unit, killng champions at low health and most minions instantly.  Every successful Feast increases Cho'Gath's health. Maximum 6 growths.

abilities.name: Threads of Vibration
abilities.text: Skarner's attacks, Shattered Earth , Upheaval , and Impale apply Quaking to targets for 4 seconds (max 3 stacks) . At 3 stacks of Quaking , enemies take 5% - 10% of their max Health as magic damage over its duration. Deals up to 100 - 450 damage against monsters.

abilities.name: Shattered Earth
abilities.text: First Cast : Grabs a boulder, empowering his next 3 attacks to gain 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% Attack Speed and deal 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 ( +100% bonus AD +4% bonus Health ) physical damage to nearby enemies. The third attack deals an additional 11% of the target's max Health as physical damage and slows by 45% for 1 second. Recast (Upheaval) : Ends this ability and throws the boulder in a target direction. The boulder explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 ( +100% bonus AD +4% bonus Health ) + 9% of the target's max Health as physical damage to them and nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 1 second. Percent Health damage to monsters from the first attack and Upheaval is capped at 200 / 250 / 300 / 350 ( +100% bonus AD +4% bonus Health ). The first two attacks deal 100% damage to structures. The third attack and Upheaval deal 200% damage to structures.

abilities.name: Seismic Bastion
abilities.text: Immediately gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% max Health for 2.5 seconds and triggers an earthquake that deals 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 ( +80% AP ) magic damage and slows nearby enemies by 25% for 1 second.

abilities.name: Ixtal's Impact
abilities.text: First cast : charges in a target direction, ignoring terrain; If he runs into an enemy champion or large monster, he drags them along for the rest of his charge; Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 ( +120% bonus AD +6% max Health ) physical damage to the enemy and stuns them for 1.5 seconds. Recast : Ends his charge early. Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow reduces Ixtal's Impact's cooldown by 35% .

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.text: Lashes his tails forward, dealing 150 / 250 / 350 ( +100% AP ) magic damage and s uppressing the first 3 enemy champions he hits for 1.5 seconds. Champions hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of the suppression . If he hits at least one enemy champion: He gains 40% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds; If Shattered Earth is active, he will cast Upheaval first.

abilities.name: Vow of the First Lands
abilities.text: Critical Strikes deal an additional 10% (per 100 AP ) magic damage .

abilities.name: Cultivation of Spirit
abilities.text: S pirit Charge (Passive) : Attacks deal an additional 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 ( +20% AP ) magic damage ; When not active, launching an attack grants 1 Unleash. Attacking again refreshes Unleash's duration. Max Unleash is 6. If the duration is not refreshed, Yunara loses 1 Unleash every 0.5 seconds. Spirit Unbound (Active) : On cast, consumes Unleash, gaining 22% / 35% / 47% / 60% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. Attacks are empowered during this time to: Deal an additional 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 ( +20% AP ) magic damage on-hit; Spread to enemies nearby the target, dealing them 18 ( 30% AD ) physical damage . Transcendent State : This ability automatically activates until Yunara exits the state. If the attack Critically Strikes, its spread damage will also Critically Strike. Damage from spread attacks is increased to 250% against minions below 30% Health.

abilities.name: Arc of Judgment / Arc of Ruin
abilities.text: Arc of Judgment: Lets rip a spinning prayer bead in the target location, briefly granting vision of the area it travels through. The prayer bead slows enemies hit by 99% , lingering as it travels and resetting its remaining duration. When it reaches its endpoint, it lingers and expands for 1 second, regardless of whether it has hit an enemy. The initial hit deals 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 ( +85% bonus AD +50% AP ) magic damage and slows by 99% , decaying over 1.5 seconds; When lingering, the bead deals an additional 8 / 14 / 20 / 26 ( +12% bonus AD +7.5% AP ) magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.25 seconds. While Yunara is in a Transcendent State, this ability is upgraded to Arc of Ruin. Arc of Ruin : Fires a laser in the target direction that deals 160 ( +120% bonus AD +75% AP ) magic damage and slows by 99% , decaying over 1.5 seconds. Arc of Judgment deals 50% - 100% damage to minions and executes low-Health minions.

abilities.name: Kanmei's Steps / Untouchable Shadow
abilities.text: Kanmei's Steps : Gains 30% / 35% / 40% / 45% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds, increased to 45% / 52.5% / 60% / 67.5% when moving toward a visible enemy champion nearby. While Yunara is in a Transcendent State, this ability is upgraded to Untouchable Shadow. Untouchable Shadow : Dashes in the target direction.

abilities.name: Transcend One's Self
abilities.text: Passive : Arc of Ruin's base damage and Untouchable Shadow's dash speed scale with this ability's level. Transcendent State (Active) : Enters a Transcendent State for 15 seconds. During this time, Yunara's basic abilities are empowered and cost no Mana. Cultivation of Spirit : Activates automatically for the duration. Arc of Judgment : Upgrades to Arc of Ruin . Its remaining cooldown reduces by 80% when Yunara enters or exits a Transcendent State. Kanmei's Steps : Upgrades to Untouchable Shadow . Its cooldown refreshes when Yunara enters or exits a Transcendent State.
